manifest.name: The display name of your behavior pack that will be shown to players.
manifest.description: A brief description of what your behavior pack does.
manifest.version: The version of your behavior pack in the format X.Y.Z (e.g., 1.0.0).
manifest.uuid: A unique identifier for your behavior pack. This should never be shared with other packs.
manifest.min_engine_version: The minimum version of Minecraft required to run this pack.

subpack.name: The display name shown to players when selecting this subpack.
subpack.folder_name: The folder name within your pack that contains this subpack's files.

structure_set.identifier: The unique identifier for this structure set, typically in the format 'namespace:name'.

jigsaw.identifier: The unique identifier for this jigsaw, typically in the format 'namespace:name'.

template_pool.identifier: The unique identifier for this template pool, typically in the format 'namespace:name'.
